duration.text: The Chemistry at China University of Mining And Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2250 USD/per year ￥ 16200 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number&expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of bachelor degree Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of bachelor degree 5. Bank Statement (No less than 20000RMB) 6. Non-criminal certificate 7. Physical examination form 8. Two recommendation letters 9. Personal Statement 10. English certificate (Duolingo test, IELTS, TOEFL)

requirements.text: Applicants should have a good school record and be in good health，the applicants for undergraduate degree should be below 35 years old.
